guide.title: Roguelite Mode Guide
guide.progressionText: Normal team victories bank {killPoints} points per personal kill. Roguelite banks remaining run points on victory, not an extra kill reward. Defeat or leaving pays nothing.
guide.unlockText: Each mode permanently unlocks Super Mode for {cost} shared points (five modes: {total}). Super victories give no points. Roguelite Super has infinite run points and unrestricted repeat ability picks. Tradeoffs still apply. Saves belong to this browser/site; clearing site data deletes them.
guide.survivalText: Survive {rounds} rounds of {seconds}s. Start with {hp} HP and {ammo} ammo. After clearing round {extract}, Extract & Win becomes available before the next enemy die. Death means defeat. HP, ammo and upgrades carry over; no automatic healing. Music stops on victory or defeat.
guide.economyText: Each kill gives {points} run points. Before rounds 2–{rounds}, receive {supply} ammo and choose at most one of {choices} abilities, or skip. Upgrade prices start at 5 and rise by 2 per purchase of that item. Repair fully heals; increasing max HP does not heal. Armor reduces each hit, minimum 1; negative armor adds damage. Ammo per point = max(1, 21 − round): 20 at R1, 1 from R20 onward. Standard shells cost 1 ammo; explosive payloads cost {payload}.
guide.abilityText: Common (white) 60%, Rare (blue) 30%, Legendary (gold) 10% per slot; offers have no duplicates. Repeated picks stack benefits and penalties. Recalibration removes one level and restores both effects. Normal level caps: Oversized/Bargain 3, Shield 1. Blast-only abilities require an explosion source. Pulse Shield starts at 3s each round, blocking [3,4), [6,7)… HP floor 25, base damage/shell speed floor 20%, movement/fire rate floor 25%. Oversized multiplies speed after that floor.
guide.enemyText: Enemy count grows from 6 to 180, HP from 90 by +3 per round; movement/fire rate start at half team-mode values. Replacements accelerate from 0.3s to 0.06s. Enemy dice have seven equal outcomes: five stats +20–60% of base, Pass, or Bomb (all five). Buffs persist; rolling locks preparation. Standard multishot and piercing do not multiply payloads. Wall bounces preserve lifetime; corners count once. Payload radius cap 150px, death nova 110px. Explosions weaken with distance. Player blasts hit enemies only; healing never revives or exceeds max HP.
guide.resultsText: WASD/arrows: move; mouse: aim; left click: fire. Roguelite uses Standard Cannon only: base damage 40, 5 shots/s, shell speed 750, life 1.5s. Results show six actual totals and round trends normalized to each metric’s own peak. Zero-kill ammo efficiency is unavailable. Hover for upgrades, ability picks and Recalibration. Shop repairs count toward the next round. New runs reset run progress, not the wallet. The translation button pauses combat, timers and transitions while settings are open.
